name: B10-0321/2026 (PPE) – Continued crackdown on civic space and fundamental freedoms in Burkina Faso
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the continued crackdown on civic space and fundamental freedoms in Burkina Faso
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Burkina Faso's military authorities to do several things: publish a credible plan to return to elected civilian rule, stop oppressing political parties, non-governmental organisations, journalists and other civil society groups, allow an independent investigation into crimes, reverse the decision to leave the International Criminal Court, and drop the death penalty. It also asks the European Union to work out a new strategy for the Sahel region.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- **Who it affects:** Burkina Faso's military authorities, and the European Union's foreign policy bodies.
- **What happens next:** Parliament sends the text to the Burkinabe government and parliament, the African Union and the European Union's foreign policy chief.
